question: Who was the writer of Badshah Nama?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Abdul Hamid Lahori.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​​Badshah Nama **is a genre of works written as the official history of the Mughal Emperor, Shah Jahan’s reign.
 
• The name of the author of Badshah Nama is** Abdul Hamid Lahori.**
 
• **Abdul Hamid Lahori** was a traveller and historian during the period of Shah Jahan who later became a court historian of Shah Jahan.
 
• He has described Shah Jahan's life and activities during the** first twenty years of his reign** in this book in great detail.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Person**
 **Important Points**
 
 

 **Abul Fazl**
 
 
 
• **Abul Fazl** was one of the nine gems of Akbar's court.
 
• He was the author of **Akbarnama **and **Ain-I-Akbari**. He also translated the Bible into the Persian language.
 
 
 
 

 Bairam Khan
 
 
 
• Bairam Khan was the commander of the Mughal Empire who cared for and guided Akbar in the early period of his rule when Akbar took over the throne at the age of 14.
 
• Bairam Khan:
 
 
• He was the army general of the Mughal Empire.
 
• He represented the Mughal army against Hemu in the 2nd battle of Panipat in 1556AD
 
 
 
 
 
 

 **Saadullah Khan**
 
 
 
• Sa'adullah Khan, also spelled Sadullah Khan ** was the Grand Vizier and Vakil-I-Mutlaq of the Mughal Empire during the reign of Shah Jahan I**
